style: Recorded close and clean in a quiet stone crypt, natural short reverb, no music, no voices, no background noise.

effects.prompt: A single soft wooden click, like a small latch closing. Very short and dry.
Two bone dice shaken and rattling together in cupped hands. Rattling only, they do not land.
Two bone dice thrown onto a stone table, landing and settling quickly.
One deep bronze church bell struck once, with a long resonant decay.
A low ominous impact with a dissonant muffled bell and a short dark rumble. Something has gone badly wrong.
A dull muted wooden knock followed by one tense low plucked string. A narrow escape.
Two soft warm notes rising on small bronze handbells. A gentle success.
A bright rising run of four small bronze handbells ending in a soft shimmer. Triumphant but restrained.
Three old coins dropped onto a wooden counter, clinking.
A small brass shop bell above a door, jingling twice.
Two soft rising notes on a glass chime. Friendly, someone has arrived.
A huge ancient bronze bell tolling once, very deep, in a vast underground chamber, with a very long decay.
A great bronze bell cracking and splitting apart with a sharp metallic fracture and a dying ring.
A stone ceiling collapsing far underground. Deep rumble with falling rubble, fading out.
